# East SOS

> > East SOS is a Ukrainian charitable foundation providing humanitarian aid, psychosocial support, and human rights education to internally displaced persons and vulnerable communities affected by conflict.

The organization operates safe spaces, mobile support brigades, and educational programs across Ukraine, particularly in Zaporizhzhia, Kyiv, Kharkiv, and other regions. East SOS focuses on women's protection, IDP assistance, and community resilience through professional social work and psychological services.

## Key Topics

- Humanitarian assistance for IDPs
- Psychosocial support services
- Women and girls safe spaces
- Human rights education
- Mobile support brigades
- Transit shelters
- Social work and case management
- Zaporizhzhia operations
- Kyiv-based programs
- Educational projects
- NGO capacity building
- Grant management
- Volunteer engagement
- Community support services
- Conflict-affected populations

## Support and Services

- [Support for organizations](https://east-sos.org/en/get-help): Request assistance and support for charitable organizations and NGOs
